msgstr: Pasan a la papelera de WooCommerce, donde puedes restaurarlos o borrarlos permanentemente. Conserva los pedidos facturados durante el plazo legal.

msgid: When you use the 3D print configurator, the model file you upload (STL, OBJ, 3MF or STEP) and the print options you choose are sent to Quote3D (quote3d.com), the service that calculates the price. Your name, email address and payment details are not sent.
msgstr: Cuando usas el configurador de impresión 3D, el archivo de modelo que subes (STL, OBJ o 3MF) y las opciones de impresión que eliges se envían a Quote3D (quote3d.com), el servicio que calcula el precio. No se envían tu nombre, tu dirección de correo electrónico ni tus datos de pago.

msgid: Quote3D keeps the model file for this shop so the part can be printed. The shop keeps the file name, a preview image and the print options with your cart and order.
msgstr: Quote3D conserva el archivo de modelo para esta tienda, de modo que la pieza pueda imprimirse. La tienda guarda el nombre del archivo, una imagen de vista previa y las opciones de impresión junto con tu carrito y tu pedido.

msgid: If the shop turned it on, model files are deleted from Quote3D some days after the order is delivered. You can ask the shop to delete your model files at any time; this is done with the personal data erasure request.
msgstr: Si la tienda lo ha activado, los archivos de modelo se borran de Quote3D unos días después de entregar el pedido. Puedes pedir a la tienda que borre tus archivos de modelo en cualquier momento; se hace mediante la solicitud de borrado de datos personales.

note: translators: keep {number}, {error} as written; they are replaced with a value.
msgid: Order #{number}: the model files could not be deleted on Quote3D ({error}). Run the request again later.
msgstr: Pedido n.º {number}: no se pudieron borrar los archivos de modelo en Quote3D ({error}). Vuelve a ejecutar la solicitud más tarde.

msgid: The cart product is not set or was deleted
msgstr: El producto del carrito no está configurado o se borró

msgid: The quote already includes tax and WooCommerce would add its own on top (Quote3D tax rate above 0, WooCommerce prices entered without tax)
msgstr: El presupuesto ya incluye impuestos y WooCommerce añadiría los suyos (tasa de impuesto de Quote3D mayor que 0, precios de WooCommerce introducidos sin impuestos)

note: translators: keep {error} as written; it is replaced with a value.
msgid: The models of this customer's unordered carts could not be deleted on Quote3D: {error}
msgstr: No se pudieron borrar en Quote3D los modelos de los carritos sin pedido de este cliente: {error}

msgid: Here is every material and colour Quote3D knows. Tick the ones you print; each becomes your own copy that you can price and stock. The quote form then offers only these. You can change it any time under Quote3D › Catalog.
msgstr: Aquí están todos los materiales y colores que conoce Quote3D. Marca los que imprimes; cada uno se convierte en tu propia copia, con tu precio y tu inventario. El formulario de presupuesto solo ofrecerá esos. Puedes cambiarlo cuando quieras en Quote3D › Catálogo.

msgid: Connect the server token first; the catalog is read from your Quote3D account. You can skip this step and do it later under Quote3D › Catalog.
msgstr: Conecta primero el token de servidor; el catálogo se lee de tu cuenta de Quote3D. Puedes omitir este paso y hacerlo luego en Quote3D › Catálogo.

note: translators: keep {count} as written; it is replaced with a value.
translators: keep {out}, {count} as written; they are replaced with a value.
msgid: Colours out of stock: {out} · need attention: {count}
The colour ran out of stock
msgstr: El color se quedó sin existencias

msgid: Sorry, there is not enough of this colour in stock right now. Please choose another colour or material.
msgstr: Lo siento, ahora mismo no hay suficientes existencias de este color. Elige otro color o material.

msgid: This quote has already been ordered. Please create a new quote to order the part again.
msgstr: Este presupuesto ya se ha pedido. Crea un presupuesto nuevo para volver a pedir la pieza.

note: translators: keep {lines} as written; it is replaced with a value.
translators: keep {lines} as written; it is replaced with a value.
translators: keep {material}, {color} as written; they are replaced with a value.
msgid: {material} {color} is not in the catalog, stock not changed
msgstr: {material} {color} no está en el catálogo, inventario sin cambios

note: translators: keep {parts} as written; it is replaced with a value.
msgid: Quote3D: these parts were already printed, so their material was not put back into stock: {parts}.
msgstr: Quote3D: estas piezas ya estaban impresas, su material no se devolvió al inventario: {parts}.

note: translators: keep {error} as written; it is replaced with a value.
msgid: Quote3D: the stock could not be updated ({error}). Check it in Quote3D › Catalog.
msgstr: Quote3D: no se pudo actualizar el inventario ({error}). Revísalo en Quote3D › Catálogo.

note: translators: keep {count} as written; it is replaced with a value.
translators: keep {out}, {count} as written; they are replaced with a value.
msgid: Colours out of stock: {out}. They cannot be picked in the quote form. Need attention: {count}.
msgstr: Colores sin existencias: {out}. No se pueden elegir en el formulario de presupuesto. Requieren atención: {count}.

msgid: Add stock with “Update stock” next to the colour; out-of-stock colours come back to the form as soon as they have stock again.
msgstr: Añade existencias con «Actualizar inventario» junto al color; los colores agotados vuelven al formulario en cuanto vuelve a haber existencias.

note: translators: keep {name} as written; it is replaced with a value.
translators: keep {name} as written; it is replaced with a value.

msgid: It leaves your catalog and the quote form. Its stock history is kept. Orders already placed are not affected.
msgstr: Sale de tu catálogo y del formulario. Su historial de inventario se conserva. Los pedidos ya hechos no se ven afectados.

note: translators: keep {name} as written; it is replaced with a value.

msgid: The quote form now shows Quote3D's ready-made list. Pick the materials and colours you really print from the full catalogue, set your own prices and, if you like, track the stock of each colour.
msgstr: El formulario muestra ahora la lista predefinida de Quote3D. Elige del catálogo completo los materiales y colores que realmente imprimes, pon tus precios y, si quieres, controla el inventario de cada color.

msgid: Quotes are priced on these machines. The widget does not ask shoppers for a printer; it uses the default one of each technology.
msgstr: Los presupuestos se calculan con estas máquinas. El widget no pregunta la impresora; usa la impresora por defecto de cada tecnología.

msgid: Each material becomes your own copy: set its price, choose its colours, track its stock.
msgstr: Cada material se convierte en tu copia: fija su precio, elige sus colores, controla su inventario.
Controlar el inventario de estos colores

note: translators: keep {material} as written; it is replaced with a value.

msgid: Off: hidden in the quote form, kept here with its stock.
msgstr: Desactivado: oculto en el formulario, se queda aquí con su inventario.

note: translators: keep {stock} as written; it is replaced with a value.
msgid: It still has {stock} in stock. Its stock history is kept, but the colour leaves the quote form. Switching it off hides it and keeps the stock.
msgstr: Aún quedan {stock} en existencias. El historial se conserva, pero el color sale del formulario. Desactivarlo lo oculta y conserva el inventario.

msgid: Paid orders take their weight (parts and supports) out of the colour's stock; cancelled orders put back what was not printed. A colour with no stock cannot be picked in the quote form.
msgstr: Los pedidos pagados descuentan su peso (piezas y soportes) del inventario del color; los cancelados devuelven lo no impreso. Un color sin existencias no se puede elegir.

msgid: Stock is not tracked; every active colour can always be picked. Switch it on to enter what you have and let orders count it down.
msgstr: El inventario no se controla; cualquier color activo se puede elegir siempre. Actívalo para introducir lo que tienes y que los pedidos lo descuenten.
Advertencia de inventario bajo a partir de

msgid: Stock is kept in grams; this lets you enter and read it in packages too.
msgstr: El inventario se lleva en gramos; así también puedes introducirlo y verlo por unidades.

note: translators: keep {color} as written; it is replaced with a value.

msgid: Material you received: it is added to the stock.
msgstr: Material recibido: se suma al inventario.

msgid: What you counted on the shelf: it replaces the stock.
msgstr: Lo que contaste en el estante: sustituye al inventario.

msgid: Failed prints, tests or damaged material: it is taken from the stock.
msgstr: Impresiones fallidas, pruebas o material dañado: se resta del inventario.

note: translators: keep {color}, {balance} as written; they are replaced with a value.

msgid: How Quote3D turns a model into a price: fees, tax, minimum price, post-processing and batch production. The same settings as the Pricing tab of the Quote3D dashboard.
msgstr: Cómo convierte Quote3D un modelo en un precio: cuotas, impuestos, precio mínimo, posprocesado y producción en serie. Los mismos ajustes que la pestaña Precios del panel de Quote3D.
Volver a los valores por defecto de Quote3D
¿Usar los precios por defecto de Quote3D?

msgid: Quote3D's default pricing is in use.
msgstr: Se usan los precios por defecto de Quote3D.

note: translators: keep {store}, {quote} as written; they are replaced with a value.
msgid: The currency of your Quote3D account changes too, so the dashboard, the widget and the API all price in {store}. Amounts are not converted: a material at 25 {quote}/kg becomes 25 {store}/kg. Check your material prices, hourly rates and fees afterwards.
msgstr: También cambia la moneda de tu cuenta de Quote3D: el panel, el widget y la API calcularán en {store}. Los importes no se convierten: un material a 25 {quote}/kg pasa a 25 {store}/kg. Revisa después los precios de materiales, las tarifas por hora y las cuotas.
